description: In the Work In Progress report the Inv. Hrs column shows two decimal places — for example +0.50, +1.24, -0.81, -14.86, and a zero reads 0.00. The Totals row does the same. One decimal place is asked for.
env: Environment: QA branch sv8582 (https://sv8582.qa.shopview.com), build v3.5-f77875c. Desktop browser, signed in as an Admin.
steps: Open Reports, then Work In Progress, and set the date range to Last 12 Months, with both locations, Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and Staging Lethbridge - 4310 selected.
Open Column Selection and switch Inv. Hrs on.
Read any value in that column, and the Totals row at the bottom. This was checked on all four tabs.
current:
Every value carries two decimal places — +0.50, +1.24, -0.81, -14.86 — and a zero reads 0.00. The Totals row does the same: +246.84, +1434.65, +0.52, +173.50.

The sign is right, the zero is correctly unsigned, the arithmetic is right and the green and red colouring is correct. It is the number of decimal places only.
expected: Inv. Hrs shows a signed number with one decimal place — the same values would read +0.5, +1.2, -0.8, -14.9 — and a zero reads 0.0, unsigned.
source: Inv. Hrs shows the quoted labor hours minus the worked (clocked) labor hours across the approved lines, as a signed number with one decimal place ("+2.0", "-14.0", "0.0"). A zero value shows unsigned as "0.0" (never "+0.0" or blank).
